page.overview:
Who is Toyo?

Toyo is a man of average height and build, with a bald head and eyes he usually keeps closed. He wears a dull yellow-and-black striped kimono, light pants, and dark shoes. In his first appearance, he was also smoking a kiseru.

Toyo is very passionate about his udon, as he was visibly agitated towards Tanjiro Kamado for discarding his bowl without eating any of it. However, once Tanjiro returned, ordered two more bowls, and gobbled them down, Toyo was pleased and thanked him for his business.

Toyo was born and raised in Asakusa. At some point in his life, he opened an udon handcart at the edge of Asakusa, as he loved the city and wanted to stay there.

During Tanjiro's second mission as a Demon Slayer, he was tasked with investigating a demonic presence in Asakusa. Overwhelmed and disoriented by his inexperience in modern cities, he quickly fled the busy, bustling center and stopped at an udon shop owned by Toyo. As he ordered an udon bowl and prepared to eat, he detected the scent that was present in his home that day when he'd found his family massacred. He stood up in shock, inadvertently causing his food to drop to the ground, and pursued the scent.
